notes.manas-2010:p0688:b001:l004: Contextually retranslated from the complete formula Ордолуу шайык көк жөкөр. Primary 1960 Semetey glossary PDF374 explicitly identifies it as an epithet of Kokand: great/holy/famous city and capital inhabited by many sheikhs. The complete formula, source image and adjacent Kyrgyz verses were individually reviewed; ordinary жөкөр dictionary footwear/retainer senses do not govern this geographic formula. Original raw text, IDs, coordinates and source lineation remain unchanged. Formula precedes Kokon/Margalang as origin of the arriving ruler. From supplies the English preposition already used in the next line.
